verdict.rationale: The docs confirm that `.get` and `.query` combine `where_document` search with metadata filtering. They also document document-level operators: `$contains`, `$not_contains`, `$regex` and `$not_regex`. A community comment corroborates the regex search. That shows a filtering capability exists, but none of the specific rich conditions in the story are evidenced. Missing for 10: range operators on metadata, geo filtering, nested boolean logic ($and/$or), array membership ($in/$nin), and any detailed metadata-filter docs or hands-on corroboration.
